package e2e

// 短测（ALLIANCE_E2E_PERF=1，单轮 ≤ 30 分钟；方案 §2.7 续期量估算、KNOWN-LIMITS 路由边界 ①⑥）：
//   - 路由 RPC 延迟：带路由缓存的客户端顺序 / 16 并发调 Info、Join；
//   - 预加载起服时间与常驻内存随“owner 是本 sid 的联盟数”（ALLIANCE_E2E_PERF_COUNTS，缺省 1000,10000）：四个实例并发建盟，
//     再用 alliance.transfer 全部转给 3000，3000 正常停机后同 sid 拉起；
//   - 续期量：拉起后 30s 内 route_renew_total{result="renewed"} 的增量，折算成每 10s。
// Mirror 回源量在 TestAllianceE2EMirrorRevalidation、一个实例上 RPC 吞吐随并发的变化在 TestAllianceE2ERPCConcurrency
// （同样只在 ALLIANCE_E2E_PERF=1 时跑）。

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"runtime"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"time"

	allianceentity "example.com/planet/game/entities/alliance"
	"example.com/planet/protocol/msgid"
	"example.com/planet/protocol/pb"
	"github.com/spf13/viper"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	coreremote "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/remoteentity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/servicerpc"
	fmongo "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/storage/mongo"
	mongodriver "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/storage/mongo/driver"
	fredis "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/storage/redis"
	redisdriver "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/storage/redis/driver"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/v2/bson"
)

func perfOnly(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("ALLIANCE_E2E_PERF") != "1" {
		t.Skip("ALLIANCE_E2E_PERF=1 not set")
	}
}

func durations(sorted []time.Duration) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("p50 %v p99 %v max %v", percentile(sorted, .5).Round(10*time.Microsecond), percentile(sorted, .99).Round(10*time.Microsecond), sorted[len(sorted)-1].Round(10*time.Microsecond))
}

func TestAllianceE2EShortPerf(t *testing.T) {
	perfOnly(t)
	s := newSuite(t, 40*time.Minute)
	counts := []int{1000, 10000}
	if raw := os.Getenv("ALLIANCE_E2E_PERF_COUNTS"); raw != "" {
		counts = nil
		for _, field := range strings.Split(raw, ",") {
			n, _ := strconv.Atoi(field)
			counts = append(counts, n)
		}
	}
	var procs []*proc
	for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
		// alliance.transfer {count} 按 owner 分页枚举、按命令期限分批（答 more 时再调），缺省的 ops.admin_timeout 10s 够用。
		procs = append(procs, s.start(fmt.Sprintf("alliance-%d", 3000+i), "alliance", int32(3000+i), procOptions{}))
	}
	a := procs[0]
	client := s.client(nil, 20*time.Second)

	// 路由 RPC 延迟（四个实例都在，联盟分在各实例；客户端带缓存）。
	ids, took := s.foundMany(client, 64, 1_000_000, 16)
	t.Logf("PERF founded 64 alliances on 4 instances in %v", took.Round(time.Millisecond))
	measure := func(name string, conc, perWorker int, call func(ctx context.Context, w, i int) error) {
		var mu sync.Mutex
		var lat []time.Duration
		failed := 0
		start := time.Now()
		var wg sync.WaitGroup
		for w := 0; w < conc; w++ {
			w := w
			wg.Add(1)
			go func() {
				defer wg.Done()
				for i := 0; i < perWorker; i++ {
					st := time.Now()
					err := call(s.ctx, w, i)
					mu.Lock()
					lat = append(lat, time.Since(st))
					if err != nil {
						failed++
					}
					mu.Unlock()
				}
			}()
		}
		wg.Wait()
		sort.Slice(lat, func(i, j int) bool { return lat[i] < lat[j] })
		t.Logf("PERF latency %s conc=%d n=%d failed=%d %.0f/s %s", name, conc, len(lat), failed, float64(len(lat))/time.Since(start).Seconds(), durations(lat))
	}
	measure("info", 1, 1000, func(ctx context.Context, w, i int) error {
		_, err := client.Info(ctx, target(t, ids[i%len(ids)]))
		return err
	})
	measure("info", 16, 125, func(ctx context.Context, w, i int) error {
		_, err := client.Info(ctx, target(t, ids[(w*125+i)%len(ids)]))
		return err
	})
	measure("info-one-instance", 16, 40, func(ctx context.Context, w, i int) error {
		_, err := client.Info(ctx, target(t, ids[0]))
		return err
	})
	measure("join", 1, 200, func(ctx context.Context, w, i int) error {
		p := int64(2_000_000 + i)
		_, err := client.Join(ctx, fmt.Sprint("perf-join-", p), p, 1000, target(t, ids[i%len(ids)]))
		return err
	})
	measure("join", 16, 25, func(ctx context.Context, w, i int) error {
		p := int64(2_100_000 + w*100 + i)
		_, err := client.Join(ctx, fmt.Sprint("perf-join-", p), p, 1000, target(t, ids[(w*25+i)%len(ids)]))
		return err
	})

	founded := len(ids)
	leaderBase := int64(3_000_000)
	for _, n := range counts {
		if more := n - founded; more > 0 {
			_, took := s.foundMany(client, more, leaderBase, 24)
			leaderBase += int64(more)
			founded = n
			t.Logf("PERF founded %d more alliances on 4 instances in %v (%.0f/s)", more, took.Round(time.Second), float64(more)/took.Seconds())
		}
		start := time.Now()
		moved, calls, partial := 0, 0, 0
		var slowest time.Duration
		for _, p := range procs[1:] {
			for {
				callStart := time.Now()
				data := s.admin(p, "alliance.transfer", map[string]any{"count": 100000, "to_sid": 3000})
				slowest = max(slowest, time.Since(callStart))
				calls++
				list, _ := data["moved"].([]any)
				pending, _ := data["pending"].([]any)
				if more, _ := data["more"].(bool); more {
					partial++
				}
				moved += len(list)
				if len(list) == 0 && len(pending) == 0 {
					break
				}
			}
		}
		t.Logf("PERF transferred %d entities (alliances and founders' guards) to 3000 in %v: %d admin calls (%d stopped at the deadline margin), slowest call %v (ops.admin_timeout 10s)",
			moved, time.Since(start).Round(time.Millisecond), calls, partial, slowest.Round(time.Millisecond))
		s.stop(a, syscall.SIGINT)
		launched := time.Now()
		s.launch(a)
		s.waitReady(a, 5*time.Minute)
		ready := time.Since(launched)
		pStart, pDone, _, report := preloadWindow(t, a.log)
		rss := rssMB(a)
		r0 := s.metric(a, "remote_entity_route_renew_total", `result="renewed"`)
		time.Sleep(30 * time.Second)
		r1 := s.metric(a, "remote_entity_route_renew_total", `result="renewed"`)
		t.Logf("PERF n=%d owned by 3000: preload listed=%d loaded=%d failed=%d took %v; start→ready %v; rss after preload %.0f MiB (30s later %.0f MiB); renewals %.0f per 10s",
			n, report.Listed, report.Loaded, report.Failed, pDone.Sub(pStart).Round(time.Millisecond), ready.Round(time.Millisecond), rss, rssMB(a), (r1-r0)/3)
	}
}

// redisCalls 是 Redis INFO commandstats 里某个命令的累计调用数。
func (s *suite) redisCalls(command string) int64 {
	info, err := s.redis.Info(s.ctx, "commandstats").Result()
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, line := range strings.Split(info, "\n") {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(line, "cmdstat_"+command+":") {
			continue
		}
		for _, field := range strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "cmdstat_"+command+":"), ",") {
			if v, ok := strings.CutPrefix(field, "calls="); ok {
				n, _ := strconv.ParseInt(strings.TrimSpace(v), 10, 64)
				return n
			}
		}
	}
	return 0
}

// TestAllianceE2EMirrorRevalidation：game 读公会走只读 Mirror（Monotonic）；推送正常时缓存的快照超过 cached_max_staleness
// 才回 L2（Redis HGET）重新确认。两轮各起一套全栈，cached_max_staleness 分别 30s / 5s：20 个玩家在 game 1000 上每 250ms 读
// 一次“我的公会”（玩家自己的副本 PlayerDao.GuildID + 联盟 Mirror；守卫不再同步给 game，snapshots=none），60s；回源量取 Redis 的 HGET 调用增量减去同长度无读取窗口的底噪。
func TestAllianceE2EMirrorRevalidation(t *testing.T) {
	perfOnly(t)
	for _, staleness := range []string{"30s", "5s"} {
		t.Run(staleness, func(t *testing.T) {
			s := newSuite(t, 15*time.Minute)
			games, _ := s.fullStack(procOptions{keys: [][3]string{{"remote_entity", "cached_max_staleness", staleness}}})
			leader := s.login(games[0], s.prefix+"-leader")
			leader.addGold(1000)
			status := leader.waitOp("found", leader.startOp("found", &pb.FoundAllianceRequest{Name: "mirror guild", OpenJoin: true}), time.Minute)
			if status.Status != "completed" {
				t.Fatalf("found: %+v", status)
			}
			var readers []*player
			for i := 0; i < 20; i++ {
				p := s.login(games[0], fmt.Sprintf("%s-r%d", s.prefix, i))
				join := call(p, msgid.MsgJoinAlliance, &pb.JoinAllianceRequest{AllianceID: status.AllianceID}, pb.MarshalJoinAllianceRequest, pb.UnmarshalAllianceResponse)
				if join.Code != 0 {
					t.Fatalf("join: %+v", join)
				}
				readers = append(readers, p)
			}
			time.Sleep(5 * time.Second)
			window := 60 * time.Second
			idle0 := s.redisCalls("hget")
			time.Sleep(window)
			idle := s.redisCalls("hget") - idle0
			busy0 := s.redisCalls("hget")
			var mu sync.Mutex
			var lat []time.Duration
			var wg sync.WaitGroup
			end := time.Now().Add(window)
			for _, p := range readers {
				wg.Add(1)
				go func(p *player) {
					defer wg.Done()
					for time.Now().Before(end) {
						st := time.Now()
						resp := p.guildInfo(0, 0)
						mu.Lock()
						lat = append(lat, time.Since(st))
						mu.Unlock()
						if resp.Code != 0 || resp.AllianceID != status.AllianceID {
							t.Errorf("guild_info: %+v", resp)
							return
						}
						time.Sleep(250 * time.Millisecond)
					}
				}(p)
			}
			wg.Wait()
			busy := s.redisCalls("hget") - busy0
			sort.Slice(lat, func(i, j int) bool { return lat[i] < lat[j] })
			t.Logf("MIRROR cached_max_staleness=%s: %d guild_info reads (1 mirror key each, 1 distinct key) in %v; Redis HGET %d (idle window %d) → %.1f revalidations/s over the idle floor; guild_info %s",
				staleness, len(lat), window, busy, idle, float64(busy-idle)/window.Seconds(), durations(lat))
		})
	}
}

// TestAllianceE2ERPCConcurrency：一个 alliance 实例上 RPC 的吞吐与延迟随并发的变化（总线接收端的派发规则，
// docs/framework/guide/09-services.md“接收端并发与顺序”）。只起 3000 一个实例，调用方带路由缓存：
//   - found：不带顺序键，各自执行；
//   - info / join：路由 RPC，顺序键是联盟实体 ID——分散到 16 个联盟时并行，集中在一个联盟时按到达顺序逐个处理。
//
// 结果按“PERF rpc <名字> conc=… n=… failed=… …/s p50 … p99 …”输出，前后对照见 docs/performance/benchmarks/rpc-dispatch-20261104。
func TestAllianceE2ERPCConcurrency(t *testing.T) {
	perfOnly(t)
	s := newSuite(t, 30*time.Minute)
	s.start("alliance-3000", "alliance", 3000, procOptions{keys: [][3]string{{"alliance", "max_members", "500"}}})
	client := s.client(nil, 60*time.Second)
	measure := func(name string, conc, perWorker int, call func(ctx context.Context, w, i int) error) {
		var mu sync.Mutex
		var lat []time.Duration
		failed := 0
		var firstErr error
		start := time.Now()
		var wg sync.WaitGroup
		for w := 0; w < conc; w++ {
			wg.Add(1)
			go func() {
				defer wg.Done()
				for i := 0; i < perWorker; i++ {
					st := time.Now()
					err := call(s.ctx, w, i)
					mu.Lock()
					lat = append(lat, time.Since(st))
					if err != nil {
						failed++
						if firstErr == nil {
							firstErr = err
						}
					}
					mu.Unlock()
				}
			}()
		}
		wg.Wait()
		elapsed := time.Since(start)
		sort.Slice(lat, func(i, j int) bool { return lat[i] < lat[j] })
		t.Logf("PERF rpc %s conc=%d n=%d failed=%d in %v %.1f/s %s", name, conc, len(lat), failed, elapsed.Round(time.Millisecond), float64(len(lat))/elapsed.Seconds(), durations(lat))
		if firstErr != nil {
			t.Logf("PERF rpc %s first error: %v", name, firstErr)
		}
	}
	var idsMu sync.Mutex
	var ids []int64
	found := func(ctx context.Context, leader int64) error {
		reply, err := client.Found(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("found-%d", leader), leader, 1000, fmt.Sprintf("p-%d", leader), true)
		if err == nil {
			idsMu.Lock()
			ids = append(ids, reply.Alliance.AllianceID)
			idsMu.Unlock()
		}
		return err
	}
	measure("found", 1, 16, func(ctx context.Context, w, i int) error { return found(ctx, int64(5_000_000+i)) })
	measure("found", 16, 8, func(ctx context.Context, w, i int) error { return found(ctx, int64(5_100_000+w*100+i)) })
	if len(ids) < 16 {
		t.Fatalf("only %d alliances founded", len(ids))
	}
	measure("info", 1, 200, func(ctx context.Context, w, i int) error {
		_, err := client.Info(ctx, target(t, ids[i%16]))
		return err
	})
	measure("info-spread16", 16, 100, func(ctx context.Context, w, i int) error {
		_, err := client.Info(ctx, target(t, ids[w]))
		return err
	})
	measure("info-same", 16, 50, func(ctx context.Context, w, i int) error {
		_, err := client.Info(ctx, target(t, ids[0]))
		return err
	})
	measure("join", 1, 32, func(ctx context.Context, w, i int) error {
		p := int64(6_000_000 + i)
		_, err := client.Join(ctx, fmt.Sprint("perf-join-", p), p, 1000, target(t, ids[1+i%15]))
		return err
	})
	measure("join-spread16", 16, 8, func(ctx context.Context, w, i int) error {
		p := int64(6_100_000 + w*100 + i)
		_, err := client.Join(ctx, fmt.Sprint("perf-join-", p), p, 1000, target(t, ids[w]))
		return err
	})
	measure("join-same", 16, 8, func(ctx context.Context, w, i int) error {
		p := int64(6_200_000 + w*100 + i)
		_, err := client.Join(ctx, fmt.Sprint("perf-join-", p), p, 1000, target(t, ids[0]))
		return err
	})
}

// TestAllianceE2EJoinRetryableSources（KNOWN-LIMITS“写额度改 512 后 256 并发仍有大量‘可重试’，来源尚未确认”）：写额度
// remote_entity.max_concurrent_writes 放到 512，一个实例、256 个联盟，256 个 worker 各往自己的联盟里不停加新玩家
// （ALLIANCE_E2E_RETRY=1 时同一请求有界退避重试），每轮 ALLIANCE_E2E_RETRY_SECONDS（缺省 15）秒、共 3 轮；“可重试”答复按错误文本归到产生它的答复点
// （wiring/remoteentity RPCWriteAnswer 的六类、路由层、alliance 模块的守卫 / 所有权读取、no responders），逐轮打 PERF 行。
// 只记录分布，不设通过门槛（来源定位用）。ALLIANCE_E2E_RETRY_WRITES 改写额度（对照用）。
func TestAllianceE2EJoinRetryableSources(t *testing.T) {
	perfOnly(t)
	writes := "512"
	if v, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("ALLIANCE_E2E_RETRY_WRITES")); err == nil && v > 0 {
		writes = strconv.Itoa(v) // 对照：缺省额度 128 时同一负载应出现“写额度满”的可重试，证明归类不是空转
	}
	effectWorkers := perfPositiveInt(t, "ALLIANCE_E2E_EFFECT_WORKERS", 16, 1024)
	workers := perfPositiveInt(t, "ALLIANCE_E2E_RETRY_CONCURRENCY", 256, 1024)
	retry := os.Getenv("ALLIANCE_E2E_RETRY") == "1"
	s := newSuite(t, 30*time.Minute)
	process := s.start("alliance-3000", "alliance", 3000, procOptions{keys: [][3]string{
		{"alliance", "max_members", "500"},
		{"remote_entity", "max_concurrent_writes", writes},
		{"dataengine.effect_consumer", "workers", strconv.Itoa(effectWorkers)},
	}})
	configured := viper.New()
	configured.SetConfigFile(process.config)
	if err := configured.ReadInConfig(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got := configured.GetInt("dataengine.effect_consumer.workers"); got != effectWorkers {
		t.Fatalf("effect_consumer.workers=%d, want %d", got, effectWorkers)
	}
	t.Logf("PERF retry-sources remote_entity.max_concurrent_writes=%s effect_consumer.workers=%d retry=%v", writes, effectWorkers, retry)
	client := s.client(nil, 60*time.Second)
	ids := make([]int64, workers)
	var foundWG sync.WaitGroup
	errs := make(chan error, workers)
	sem := make(chan struct{}, 16)
	for w := range workers {
		foundWG.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer foundWG.Done()
			sem <- struct{}{}
			defer func() { <-sem }()
			leader := int64(7_000_000 + w)
			for attempt := 0; ; attempt++ {
				reply, err := client.Found(s.ctx, fmt.Sprintf("found-%d", leader), leader, 1000, fmt.Sprintf("r-%d", leader), true)
				if err == nil {
					ids[w] = reply.Alliance.AllianceID
					return
				}
				if servicerpc.Classify(err) != servicerpc.OutcomeRetryable || attempt > 50 {
					errs <- fmt.Errorf("found %d: %w", leader, err)
					return
				}
				time.Sleep(30 * time.Millisecond)
			}
		}()
	}
	foundWG.Wait()
	close(errs)
	for err := range errs {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	seconds := 15
	if v, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("ALLIANCE_E2E_RETRY_SECONDS")); err == nil && v > 0 {
		seconds = v
	}
	digits := regexp.MustCompile(`[0-9]+`)
	reason := func(err error) string {
		text := err.Error()
		for _, known := range []string{
			"overloaded", "queue full", "queue is full", "reloading", "owner transition", "version conflict", "fenced",
			"no responders", "ownership manager is not ready", "ask alliance", "heal the guard", "read the owner",
		} {
			if strings.Contains(text, known) {
				return known
			}
		}
		text = digits.ReplaceAllString(text, "N")
		if len(text) > 120 {
			text = text[:120]
		}
		return "other: " + text
	}
	var next int64 = 8_000_000
	succeeded := make([]int, workers)
	unknown := 0
	for round := 1; round <= 3; round++ {
		var mu sync.Mutex
		outcomes := map[servicerpc.Outcome]int{}
		reasons := map[string]int{}
		samples := map[string]string{}
		logical, exhausted := 0, 0
		deadline := time.Now().Add(time.Duration(seconds) * time.Second)
		start := time.Now()
		var wg sync.WaitGroup
		for w := range workers {
			wg.Add(1)
			go func() {
				defer wg.Done()
				for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
					mu.Lock()
					next++
					player := next
					mu.Unlock()
					// 重试沿用 request ID 与玩家号；只重试明确未完成的 retryable，unknown 不猜是否生效。
					for attempt := 0; ; attempt++ {
						_, err := client.Join(s.ctx, fmt.Sprint("retry-src-", player), player, 1000, target(t, ids[w]))
						outcome := servicerpc.Classify(err)
						mu.Lock()
						outcomes[outcome]++
						if outcome == servicerpc.OutcomeOK {
							succeeded[w]++
						}
						if outcome == servicerpc.OutcomeRetryable || outcome == servicerpc.OutcomeUnknown {
							key := outcome.String() + " / " + reason(err)
							reasons[key]++
							if _, ok := samples[key]; !ok {
								samples[key] = err.Error()
							}
						}
						again := retry && outcome == servicerpc.OutcomeRetryable && attempt < 7 && time.Now().Before(deadline)
						if !again {
							logical++
							if retry && outcome == servicerpc.OutcomeRetryable {
								exhausted++
							}
						}
						mu.Unlock()
						if !again {
							break
						}
						delay := min(10*time.Millisecond<<attempt, 200*time.Millisecond)
						select {
						case <-time.After(delay):
						case <-s.ctx.Done():
							return
						}
					}
				}
			}()
		}
		wg.Wait()
		unknown += outcomes[servicerpc.OutcomeUnknown]
		elapsed := time.Since(start)
		t.Logf("PERF retry-sources round=%d conc=%d seconds=%.1f ok=%d (%.1f/s) rejected=%d retryable=%d unknown=%d",
			round, workers, elapsed.Seconds(), outcomes[servicerpc.OutcomeOK], float64(outcomes[servicerpc.OutcomeOK])/elapsed.Seconds(),
			outcomes[servicerpc.OutcomeRejected], outcomes[servicerpc.OutcomeRetryable], outcomes[servicerpc.OutcomeUnknown])
		t.Logf("PERF retry-sources round=%d logical=%d retry_exhausted=%d (outcomes count attempts, logical counts completed callers)", round, logical, exhausted)
		keys := make([]string, 0, len(reasons))
		for key := range reasons {
			keys = append(keys, key)
		}
		sort.Slice(keys, func(i, j int) bool { return reasons[keys[i]] > reasons[keys[j]] })
		for _, key := range keys {
			t.Logf("PERF retry-sources round=%d %6d  %s   e.g. %s", round, reasons[key], key, samples[key])
		}
	}
	total := 0
	for w, accepted := range succeeded {
		total += accepted
		if unknown == 0 {
			info, err := client.Info(s.ctx, target(t, ids[w]))
			if err != nil || len(info.Alliance.Members) != 1+accepted {
				t.Fatalf("worker %d: members=%d want=%d err=%v", w, len(info.Alliance.Members), 1+accepted, err)
			}
		}
	}
	if total == 0 {
		t.Fatal("retry probe completed no successful joins")
	}
	if unknown > 0 {
		t.Logf("PERF retry-sources: %d unknown outcomes require reconciliation; final roster equality is not claimed", unknown)
	}
}

func perfPositiveInt(t *testing.T, name string, fallback, maximum int) int {
	t.Helper()
	raw := os.Getenv(name)
	if raw == "" {
		return fallback
	}
	n, err := strconv.Atoi(raw)
	if err != nil || n <= 0 || n > maximum {
		t.Fatalf("%s=%q must be in 1..%d", name, raw, maximum)
	}
	return n
}

// 正式业务链路仍遵守 500 人硬上限。超过上限的形状成本需要独立探针，不能把它说成已支持大联盟。
func TestAllianceE2ELargeAllianceFootprint(t *testing.T) {
	perfOnly(t)
	count := perfPositiveInt(t, "ALLIANCE_E2E_MEMBERS", 500, 500)
	copies := perfPositiveInt(t, "ALLIANCE_E2E_MIRROR_COPIES", 16, 128)
	s := newSuite(t, 30*time.Minute)
	s.start("alliance-3000", "alliance", 3000, procOptions{keys: [][3]string{{"alliance", "max_members", "500"}}})
	client := s.client(nil, 30*time.Second)
	const leader int64 = 6_000_000
	founded := s.found(client, leader)
	id := target(t, founded.Alliance.AllianceID)
	for i := 1; i < count; i++ {
		player := leader + int64(i)
		err, _ := definite(s.ctx, 30*time.Second, func(ctx context.Context) error {
			_, err := client.Join(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("footprint-%d", player), player, 1000, id)
			return err
		})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	info, err := client.Info(s.ctx, id)
	if err != nil || len(info.Alliance.Members) != count {
		t.Fatalf("roster: %+v, %v", info, err)
	}
	var document bson.Raw
	collection := s.mongo.Database(s.prefix).Collection("alliance")
	documents, err := collection.CountDocuments(s.ctx, bson.M{})
	if err != nil || documents != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("stored alliances=%d, err=%v", documents, err)
	}
	if err := collection.FindOne(s.ctx, bson.M{}).Decode(&document); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// Remote 文档的 data 是 DAO BSON，元数据在外层；不能把业务字段当作集合顶层筛选。
	var stored struct {
		Data []byte `bson:"data"`
	}
	if err := bson.Unmarshal(document, &stored); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	decoded, err := allianceentity.DecodeAllianceMirror(stored.Data)
	if err != nil || decoded.LeaderID != leader || len(decoded.Members) != count {
		t.Fatalf("stored roster differs: leader=%d members=%d err=%v", decoded.LeaderID, len(decoded.Members), err)
	}

	// 复用正式只读客户端：Redis L2 + Mongo 权威回填 + 生成的 Mirror 解码器。
	// 这里刻意不 Start 推送，测量按需冷读；共享连接的基线在 GC 取样前已建立。
	redis, err := redisdriver.NewClient(fredis.DefaultConfig(s.redisAddr))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer redis.Close()
	mongo, err := mongodriver.NewClient(fmongo.DefaultConfig(s.mongoURI), mongodriver.IndexMigrationPolicy{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer mongo.Close(context.Background())
	cfg := coreremote.DefaultConfig()
	cfg.SnapshotL2KeyPrefix = s.prefix
	l2, err := coreremote.NewSnapshotL2StoreFromConfig(redis, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	loader := coreremote.NewMongoSnapshotLoader(mongo, s.prefix+"_remote")
	newReader := func(sid int32) (*coreremote.SnapshotClient, *entity.RemoteMirrorReader[allianceentity.AllianceMirror]) {
		t.Helper()
		client, err := coreremote.NewSnapshotClient(cfg, coreremote.SnapshotClientDeps{L2: l2, Loader: loader, ConsumerSID: sid})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		reader, err := allianceentity.NewAllianceMirrorReader(client)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return client, reader
	}
	// 先建立共享连接并预热解码元数据，再丢掉临时 L1；避免把首次连接分配算成每份 Mirror 成本。
	func() {
		warm, reader := newReader(9199)
		defer warm.Stop(context.Background())
		value, found, err := reader.Read(s.ctx, id, entity.RemoteReadMonotonic, entity.RemoteObservation{StateVersion: uint64(info.Alliance.Version)})
		if err != nil || !found || len(value.Value.Members) != count {
			t.Fatalf("warm mirror: found=%v err=%v", found, err)
		}
	}()
	clients := make([]*coreremote.SnapshotClient, copies)
	readers := make([]*entity.RemoteMirrorReader[allianceentity.AllianceMirror], copies)
	for i := range clients {
		clients[i], readers[i] = newReader(int32(9200 + i))
		defer clients[i].Stop(context.Background())
	}
	values := make([]entity.RemoteMirrorValue[allianceentity.AllianceMirror], copies)
	runtime.GC()
	var before, after runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&before)
	latency := make([]time.Duration, copies)
	for i, reader := range readers {
		start := time.Now()
		value, found, err := reader.Read(s.ctx, id, entity.RemoteReadMonotonic, entity.RemoteObservation{StateVersion: uint64(info.Alliance.Version)})
		latency[i] = time.Since(start)
		if err != nil || !found || len(value.Value.Members) != count {
			t.Fatalf("mirror %d: found=%v members=%d err=%v", i, found, len(value.Value.Members), err)
		}
		values[i] = value
	}
	runtime.GC()
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&after)
	sort.Slice(latency, func(i, j int) bool { return latency[i] < latency[j] })
	t.Logf("PERF alliance-footprint members=%d bson_document_bytes=%d dao_payload_bytes=%d mirrors=%d retained_heap_delta_bytes=%d per_mirror_bytes=%d cold_read_%s", count, len(document), len(stored.Data), copies, int64(after.HeapAlloc)-int64(before.HeapAlloc), (int64(after.HeapAlloc)-int64(before.HeapAlloc))/int64(copies), durations(latency))
	// 保留 L1 缓存和独立解码 DTO 到测量结束；HeapAlloc 是含少量连接噪声的进程差值，不是 RSS。
	runtime.KeepAlive(values)
	runtime.KeepAlive(readers)
	runtime.KeepAlive(info)
	runtime.KeepAlive(document)
	runtime.KeepAlive(decoded)
}
